from solution import Find_Min


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: Find_Min([[1],[1,2],[1,2,3]]) == [1]."""
    # len([1])=1, len([1,2])=2, len([1,2,3])=3, so min is [1]
    assert Find_Min([[1], [1, 2], [1, 2, 3]]) == [1]


def test_issue_min_at_end():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length when shortest is last."""
    # len([1,2,3])=3, len([1,2])=2, len([1])=1, so min is [1]
    assert Find_Min([[1, 2, 3], [1, 2], [1]]) == [1]


def test_issue_min_in_middle():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length when shortest is in middle."""
    # len([1,2,3])=3, len([1])=1, len([1,2])=2, so min is [1]
    assert Find_Min([[1, 2, 3], [1], [1, 2]]) == [1]


def test_issue_single_sublist():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length from a single sublist."""
    # only candidate len([9,8,7])=3, so min is [9,8,7]
    assert Find_Min([[9, 8, 7]]) == [9, 8, 7]


def test_issue_empty_sublist_is_minimum():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length when one sublist is empty."""
    # len([1])=1, len([])=0, so min is []
    assert Find_Min([[1], []]) == []


def test_issue_lengths_differ_by_one():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length for lengths just above threshold."""
    # len([1,2])=2, len([1,2,3])=3, 3-2=1, so min is [1,2]
    assert Find_Min([[1, 2], [1, 2, 3]]) == [1, 2]


def test_issue_tie_has_minimal_length():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length when two sublists tie."""
    # len([1,2,3])=3, len([1])=1, len([2])=1, so min length is 1
    assert Find_Min([[1, 2, 3], [1], [2]]) in [[1], [2]]


def test_issue_uses_length_not_values():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length regardless of element values."""
    # len(['aa','bb'])=2, len(['c'])=1, so min is ['c']
    assert Find_Min([["aa", "bb"], ["c"]]) == ["c"]


def test_issue_returns_sublist_not_length():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length, returning the sublist itself."""
    # len([1,2])=2, len([1])=1, so min sublist is [1] not integer 1
    assert Find_Min([[1, 2], [1]]) == [1]


def test_contract_result_is_member_of_input():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length, returning an element of the input."""
    # len([5,6,7,8])=4, len([1,2])=2, len([9])=1, len([4,5,6])=3, so min is [9]
    assert Find_Min([[5, 6, 7, 8], [1, 2], [9], [4, 5, 6]]) in [[5, 6, 7, 8], [1, 2], [9], [4, 5, 6]]


def test_contract_input_not_mutated():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length without changing the input."""
    # len([1,2,3])=3, len([1])=1, copy is [[1,2,3],[1]] before call
    data = [[1, 2, 3], [1]]
    Find_Min(data)
    assert data == [[1, 2, 3], [1]]


def test_contract_returns_list_type():
    """Find the sublist having minimum length, returning a list."""
    # len([1,2])=2, len([1,2,3])=3, len([1])=1, so min [1] is a list
    assert isinstance(Find_Min([[1, 2], [1, 2, 3], [1]]), list)
